content.text:
* Folded-cascode NMOS-input first stage + NMOS CS second stage, Miller Cc+Rz
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* ---- bias: IREF=10u into IBIAS, NMOS unit 5uA = W10 L2
XMNR IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=2 m=2
XMNT TAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=2 m=6
* PMOS bias diode (5uA) and level-shifted PMOS cascode bias
XMNPB VBP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=2 m=1
XMPB VBP VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=5 m=1
* separate branch for cascode bias so its headroom cannot starve VBP
XMPB2 VBPX VBPX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=5 m=1
R1 VBPX VBPC 60k
XMNPB2 VBPC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=2 m=1
* NMOS cascode bias: PMOS 5uA source -> R2 -> NMOS diode
XMPNB VBNC VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=5 m=1
R2 VBNC VBNX 40k
XMNC VBNX VBNX VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=3 L=6 m=1
* ---- input pair (VINN on mirror-input side)
XM1 FA VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=2 m=6
XM2 FB VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=2 m=6
* ---- PMOS fold sources 40uA (> 30uA tail)
XM3A FA VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=5 m=8
XM3B FB VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=5 m=8
* ---- PMOS cascodes
XM4A NA VBPC FA VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=40 L=1 m=1
XM4B N1 VBPC FB VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=40 L=1 m=1
* ---- NMOS cascoded mirror
XM6A NA VBNC XA VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 m=1
XM6B N1 VBNC XB VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 m=1
XM5A XA NA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=4 m=1
XM5B XB NA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=4 m=1
* ---- second stage
XM7 VOUT N1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=20 L=1 m=1
XM8 VOUT VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=5 m=16
* output shunt: trims excess DC gain (CMRR balance bisection margin)
RL VOUT VSS 60k
* ---- Miller compensation
RZ N1 NZ 2k
CC NZ VOUT 11p
.ends DUT
